label: human oversight
definition: The requirement for deployers to assign natural persons with necessary competence, training, authority, and support to oversee the AI system.
source_quote: Deployers shall assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority, as well as the necessary support.

label: input data is relevant and sufficiently representative
definition: The duty for deployers exercising control over input data to ensure it is relevant and sufficiently representative for the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.
source_quote: that deployer shall ensure that input data is relevant and sufficiently representative in view of the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

label: monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system
definition: The obligation for deployers to monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system based on instructions for use and inform providers or authorities of risks or serious incidents.
source_quote: Deployers shall monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions for use

label: keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system
definition: The duty for deployers to keep automatically generated logs under their control for a period appropriate to the intended purpose, at least six months.
source_quote: Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under their control

label: inform workers' representatives and affected workers
definition: The obligation for employer deployers to inform workers' representatives and affected workers before putting a high-risk AI system into service or using it at the workplace.
source_quote: deployers who are employers shall inform workers' representatives and the affected workers that they will be subject to the use of the high-risk AI system

label: comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49
definition: The duty for public authority deployers to comply with registration obligations and not use unregistered systems found in the EU database.
source_quote: Deployers of high-risk AI systems that are public authorities, or Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies shall comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49

label: use information provided under Article 13 to comply with data protection impact assessment obligation
definition: The requirement for deployers to use information from the provider to carry out a data protection impact assessment under GDPR or Law Enforcement Directive.
source_quote: deployers of high-risk AI systems shall use the information provided under Article 13 of this Regulation to comply with their obligation to carry out a data protection impact assessment

label: request an authorisation for post-remote biometric identification
definition: The obligation for deployers of post-remote biometric identification systems in criminal investigations to request prior or immediate authorization from a judicial or administrative authority.
source_quote: the deployer of a high-risk AI system for post-remote biometric identification shall request an authorisation, ex ante, or without undue delay and no later than 48 hours

label: no untargeted use for law enforcement purposes
definition: The requirement that post-remote biometric identification systems shall not be used for law enforcement purposes in an untargeted way without a link to a criminal offence or specific threat.
source_quote: In no case shall such high-risk AI system for post-remote biometric identification be used for law enforcement purposes in an untargeted way

label: submit annual reports on use of post-remote biometric identification systems
definition: The duty for deployers to submit annual reports to market surveillance and national data protection authorities on their use of post-remote biometric identification systems.
source_quote: Deployers shall submit annual reports to the relevant market surveillance and national data protection authorities on their use of post-remote biometric identification systems

label: inform natural persons subject to the use of the high-risk AI system
definition: The obligation for deployers making decisions or assisting in decisions related to natural persons to inform those persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system.
source_quote: deployers of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III that make decisions or assist in making decisions related to natural persons shall inform the natural persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system

label: cooperate with relevant competent authorities
definition: The duty for deployers to cooperate with relevant competent authorities in any action taken in relation to the high-risk AI system to implement the Regulation.
source_quote: Deployers shall cooperate with the relevant competent authorities in any action those authorities take in relation to the high-risk AI system
